script: LA -12.5 with a 51 total points to a Rams win around 32-19, so Kyren Williams (47 carries, 217 rush yards over weeks 3-5) keeps the lead-back role while Arizona trails and has to throw with Jacoby Brissett. That negative script buries Tyler Allgeier, who has only 13 carries for 48 yards in those three games behind J.Love's 47 carries. Blake Corum (16 carries, 48 yards) is a mop-up back only if LA is up multiple scores late.
who_goes_off: Davante Adams (29 targets, 220 yards, 434 air yards) and Puka Nacua (36 targets, 263 yards, 320 air yards) are the explosives into an Arizona defense that has allowed 18 passes of 20+ and 9.57/9.62 YPA on the left and right. Kyren Williams is the volume piece at 72.3 rush yards and 54.7 receiving yards per game against a run defense allowing 4.42 YPC and 17 runs of 10+.
weak_spot: LA is softest in the middle at 6.79 YPA on 28 attempts versus 5.62 left (60 attempts) and 5.14 right (58 attempts), with only 9 passes of 20+ on 157 attempts, so the matchup is intermediate middle — linebackers, nickel, safeties — not outside corners. Arizona is the reverse: sidelines at 9.57 left and 9.62 right, middle still 7.71, plus 18 explosives, which is Adams and Nacua. LA also allows 4.59 YPC and 17 runs of 10+, a rush lane for Kyren Williams.
injury_fallout: No injury designations were saved for ARI@LA, so J.Love's 47 carries are not assumed vacated and Tyler Higbee's 23 targets are not assumed split with Colby Parkinson. The bettable split stays J.Love 47 carries/175 yards versus Tyler Allgeier 13 carries/48 yards, and the LA target order stays Puka Nacua 36, Davante Adams 29, Kyren Williams 28, Tyler Higbee 23.
qb_vs_blitz: Jacoby Brissett is -0.34 EPA per dropback vs blitz on 62 dropbacks and +0.15 when not blitzed, and LA blitzes 34%, so Arizona efficiency should sag and Michael Wilson's 386 air yards on 37 targets clash with a defense that has allowed only 9 passes of 20+. Matthew Stafford is -0.14 EPA vs blitz and +0.23 clean, and Arizona blitzes only 25%, so he spends most of the night in the better split that feeds Nacua, Adams, Higbee, and Kyren Williams checkdowns.

picks.why: Kyren Williams has 28 targets and 164 receiving yards over the last 3 games (54.7 per game) against a 19.5 line. Even a blowout cut from 9.3 targets to 4 still clears 19.5 at his 5.9 yards per target, and Arizona blitzes only 25% so Stafford (+0.23 EPA without blitz) can keep dumping off.

Tyler Allgeier has 13 carries for 48 yards and 8 targets for 26 yards over 3 games, about 25 rush+rec yards per game, while J.Love has taken 47 carries. As a +12.5 road dog that volume shrinks further once Arizona trails, and 64.5 is more than double his recent weekly output.
